stories.title: Droni russi su Kiev durante la visita di Merz. Zelensky: Usa vogliono colloqui trilaterali a ottobre

en.title: Russian drones over Kyiv during Merz visit. Zelensky: USA wants trilateral talks in October
en.summary: Germany and Ukraine agreed on a partnership for missile and interceptor drone systems during a visit by German politician Merz. Russia conducted drone attacks on Kyiv, while Italy's embassy reaffirmed its presence there despite Moscow's threats.

stories.title: Media, dopo bocciatura decreti casa Sanchez verso annuncio elezioni anticipate

en.title: Media: after decree rejection, Sanchez expected to announce early elections
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Sanchez is expected to announce early elections following the rejection of government decrees, while officials consider how to reintroduce the failed measures.

stories.title: Flydubai, “il copilota voleva far schiantare l’aereo sull’aeroporto Ben Gurion”

en.title: Flydubai: copilot allegedly intended to crash plane at Ben Gurion airport
en.summary: A 29-year-old copilot allegedly planned to crash the aircraft at Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion airport or a U.S. military base in Jordan, according to initial interrogation details. He reportedly acted alone.

stories.title: Dramma a Torino: tenta di strangolare la compagna e poi si lancia dal decimo piano

en.title: Tragedy in Turin: man attempts to strangle partner then jumps from tenth floor
en.summary: A woman escaped strangulation by feigning death and fled with her one-year-old daughter. No prior incidents or warning signs had been recorded.

stories.title: Media, copilota voleva schiantare volo FlyDubai su aeroporto Ben Gurion

en.title: Media report: FlyDubai copilot wanted to crash plane on Ben Gurion airport
en.summary: A FlyDubai copilot allegedly planned to crash a flight onto Ben Gurion Airport, according to media reports.

stories.title: Merz a Kiev accolto dai droni russi: colpito un altro ponte sul Dnipro

en.title: Merz in Kyiv welcomed by Russian drones: another bridge struck on Dnipro
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz made a surprise visit to Kyiv offering military aid while proposing negotiations with Putin, as Russian forces continued bombing Ukrainian infrastructure including a bridge over the Dnipro River.

stories.title: Garlasco, i genitori di Chiara in tv: "Per noi colpevole resta Stasi"

en.title: Garlasco, parents of Chiara on TV: "For us Stasi remains guilty"
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi reiterated their belief in Stasi's guilt after eight years of judicial proceedings ended in his conviction, stating they will evaluate new investigation developments only if magistrates reach different conclusions.

stories.title: Flydubai, il copilota voleva schiantarsi sul Ben Gurion. In Israele è scontro sulla sicurezza

en.title: FlyDubai, copilot wanted to crash onto Ben Gurion. In Israel, security debate escalates
en.summary: Israel's Transport Ministry and security services disputed responsibility for oversight gaps after interrogations revealed a FlyDubai copilot's alleged crash plan, reigniting debate over crew safety controls weeks before elections.

stories.title: Genitori Chiara Poggi, 'prenderemo atto se giustizia darà altro colpevole'

en.title: Parents of Chiara Poggi: 'We will accept if justice finds another culprit'
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi were interviewed on television, stating that after five trials over eight years, they believe Stasi is responsible for their daughter's death.

stories.title: Garlasco, i Poggi in tv: “Il colpevole resta Stasi, se ci saranno altre sentenze ne prenderemo atto”

en.title: Garlasco, the Poggi family on TV: 'The culprit remains Stasi, we will accept other verdicts if they come'
en.summary: Chiara Poggi's parents broke their silence in a television interview, expressing that they want closure and believe their daughter deserves to rest in peace.

stories.title: I genitori di Chiara Poggi: “Ha diritto di riposare in pace. Stasi per noi è colpevole fino a nuovo processo”

en.title: Parents of Chiara Poggi: 'She deserves to rest in peace. Stasi is guilty for us until a new trial'
en.summary: The couple stated on television that they consider Stasi responsible, though they will acknowledge if the justice system determines otherwise in future proceedings.

stories.title: Tenta di strangolare la compagna: lei fugge con la bimba di un anno, lui si butta giù dal balcone

en.title: Man attempts to strangle partner: she flees with one-year-old child, he jumps from balcony
en.summary: An incident occurred in Milan's Barriera di Milano neighborhood where a man jumped from the tenth floor after attempting to harm his partner.

stories.title: Sbarca a Olbia il Sardinia boat show

en.title: Sardinia boat show launches in Olbia
en.summary: Sardinia's maritime fair relocated from Porto Rotondo to Olbia and was renamed the Sardinia boat show. The upcoming edition will be held in the new location.

stories.title: Barcolana, la festa del mare conquista Trieste

en.title: Barcolana, the sea festival conquers Trieste
en.summary: The Barcolana, an international sailing regatta in its 58th edition and presented by Generali, takes place next weekend in Trieste, marking the conclusion of the summer racing season.

stories.title: La stagione più lunga: l’Arena di Verona raggiunge il record di incassi

en.title: The longest season: Verona's Arena reaches record box office
en.summary: The Verona Arena achieved nearly 37 million euros in ticket sales over more than three months of performances, with audiences under 30 representing over 11 percent of total attendance.

stories.title: L’ex fabbrica di rame diventa luogo di cura per più di 100 patologie

en.title: The former copper factory becomes a care facility for more than 100 diseases
en.summary: Dynamo Camp, established in 2007 as a summer facility providing free stays for children with cancer, has evolved over two decades into a treatment center addressing numerous conditions.

stories.title: Posti barca, in Italia sono 172mila ma solo il 2% è dedicato ai superyacht

en.title: Boat berths, Italy has 172,000 but only 2% are dedicated to superyachts
en.summary: Italy has 172,000 boat berths, with only 2% designated for vessels over 24 meters. Liguria and Toscana regions account for approximately half of the superyacht capacity.
